# B-Acoustics

> B-Acoustics is an acoustic engineering and soundproofing consultancy based in Singapore. We design, model, and build noise control for commercial, residential, and industrial spaces — from open-office acoustic panels and party-wall sound isolation to industrial boundary-noise compliance.

Singapore-only, B2B and B2C. We do not quote firm pricing without a site survey. Client confidentiality is the default — project photos are only shown with explicit consent, and are named only when the client agrees to it (otherwise described generically, e.g. "Corporate Office"). Every acoustic claim we make is backed by on-site measurement (Class 1 sound-level meters, impulse-response capture, tapping-machine testing), not estimates.

## Services

- [Office Acoustics](https://b-acoustics.com/services/office-acoustics-singapore.html): Acoustic treatment for open-plan and commercial offices — reverberation control, speech privacy, ceiling/wall panel systems.
- [Party-Wall Soundproofing](https://b-acoustics.com/services/party-wall-soundproofing-singapore.html): Sound isolation between units — home theatres, HDB/condo party walls, staggered-stud and resilient-channel construction.
- [Industrial Noise Compliance](https://b-acoustics.com/services/industrial-noise-compliance-singapore.html): Boundary noise reduction and NEA compliance for industrial plant — duct silencers, enclosures, vibration isolation.

- [Guides index](https://b-acoustics.com/blog/): All published guides.
- [STC vs NRC Explained](https://b-acoustics.com/blog/stc-vs-nrc-explained.html): The difference between Sound Transmission Class (blocking sound) and Noise Reduction Coefficient (absorbing sound), and how each relates to NEA's dB(A) boundary limits.
- [Office Soundproofing Cost in Singapore](https://b-acoustics.com/blog/office-soundproofing-cost-singapore.html): What drives the cost of a commercial acoustic project.
- [HDB vs Condo Soundproofing](https://b-acoustics.com/blog/hdb-vs-condo-soundproofing-singapore.html): How approval processes and construction differ between HDB and condo/MCST projects.
- [NEA Boundary Noise Limits in Singapore](https://b-acoustics.com/blog/nea-boundary-noise-limits-singapore.html): NEA's dB(A) limits for industrial and commercial premises, explained.
- [Home Theatre Soundproofing Cost](https://b-acoustics.com/blog/home-theatre-soundproofing-cost-singapore.html): What a residential home-theatre isolation build typically costs and why.
- [Neighbour Noise in Singapore: Your Options](https://b-acoustics.com/blog/neighbour-noise-singapore.html): Mediation, complaint channels, and construction options for noisy-neighbour disputes.
